_comment: QR / NFC provisioning payload for HKids dedicated tablets (Android 7+).
Encode this JSON as a QR code and scan it from the 'Welcome' screen of a
factory-reset tablet (tap the screen 6 times to open the QR reader).
DOWNLOAD_LOCATION  -> HTTPS URL serving the signed release APK
SIGNATURE_CHECKSUM -> url-safe base64 SHA-256 of the signing certificate:
then base64url-encode the SHA-256 digest bytes without padding.
Remove every _comment field before encoding: unknown keys are rejected.
